summary: Enhance your skills with our Integrated Property and Project Management Training. Gain practical knowledge to excel in the real estate and project sectors.
lede: Integrated Property and Project Management connects day-to-day asset operations with capital project delivery, helping professionals align maintenance, development goals, costs, and risks. This course addresses fragmented oversight by combining lifecycle thinking with structured project and facility management practices. You will learn to assess property upgrades through Lifecycle Costing and Net Present Value calculations, establish governance that limits scope creep, and plan predictive maintenance with AI-driven analytics. The training also covers the transition from project handover to operational steady state, sustainable resource allocation, digital tools, and the strategic use of Digital Twins, with content aligned to ISO 41001 and the RICS professional framework.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals responsible for the strategic and operational success of real estate portfolios and capital works.
modules: Strategic Alignment of Property and Project Portfolios
Project Management Frameworks for Real Estate Assets
Operational Excellence in Property and Facility Management
Risk Mitigation and Compliance in Asset Management
Sustainable Asset Management and ESG Integration
Digital Transformation: BIM, IWMS, and AI Analytics
Integrated Strategy Synthesis and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in property management, facility management, or construction project management. A basic understanding of financial statements (Balance Sheets, P&L) and familiarity with standard project management terminology is required. No prior coding or advanced software knowledge is necessary, though a laptop with spreadsheet software is required for financial modeling exercises.
